newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin sacks several top generals.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin sacks several top generals.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has sacked several senior generals, including commanders of the paratroop and space forces, the Defence Ministry said on Friday.
A ministry spokesman said Yeltsin's decrees had been signed on Wednesday and Thursday. He had no texts and Kremlin press service could not confirm the decrees.
The ministry said at least three senior generals had been removed, including a first deputy head of the general staff.
Media reports said on Friday the sackings were part of a reshuffle conducted by Defence Minister Igor Rodionov aimed at consolidating his power among the top ranks.
His main brief is to try to reform the armed forces -- something his predecessor Pavel Grachev failed to do.

"The new defence minister is clearly ready to reform and cut the armed forces resolutely, unhesitantly resorting to unpopular measures and sacking any top general who is not ready to follow his policy," said the liberal Sevodnya broadsheet on Friday.
Russian media have said paratroop commander General Yevgeny Podkolzin had resisted Rodionov's plans to cut his force.
